segments.name: 3D printing solutions
segments.description: Supplies polymer-based additive manufacturing systems, materials, software and services to manufacturers, prototypers and end-users across many industries worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Company has one operating segment, which generates revenues via the sale of its 3D printing systems, related services and consumables and by providing additive manufacturing ("AM") solutions.

revenueModel.text: End-users and resellers pay for printing systems, consumables, software and service contracts, generating recurring revenue after the initial system sale.
revenueModel.evidence: Our business model is predicated in part on building an end-user base that will generate a recurring stream of revenues through our sale of consumables and service contracts.

changes.text: In 2025 the company continued restructuring activities under which certain operations were discontinued and others were divested.
changes.evidence: In connection with these activities, certain operations were discontinued, and others were divested.
